prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Marc S. Wright at Wright Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone, but **Dr. Marc S. Wright at Wright Orthodontics** looks like a strong all-around option from the information available: the practice offers both braces and Invisalign, identifies Dr. Wright as board-certified, and has a reported 5-star rating across 633 Google reviews. It’s at **3019 N. Druid Hills Rd. NE, Suite B**. [Practice details](https://drwrightortho.com/location/orthodontist-in-atlanta-ga/) · [Review listing](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/georgia/atlanta-ga/orthodontists/wright-orthodontics-atlanta-ga)

Other good candidates to compare:
- **Buckhead Orthodontics / Dr. Michael Everson** — board-certified; offers several braces options and in-house clear aligners. [Website](https://www.buckheadorthodontics.com/)
- **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** — board-certified orthodontists and a strong Invisalign focus. [Website](https://www.westpacesferryortho.com/)

I’d book two or three consultations before deciding. Ask who will supervise your treatment, whether your case is suitable for Invisalign or braces, what’s included in the quoted fee, and how refinements and retainers are handled. The best fit depends on your bite, treatment goals, budget, and location.
